newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: APRIL Riaupulp completes power asset sale.
newsitem.headline: APRIL Riaupulp completes power asset sale.

text.p: P.T. Riau Andalan Pulp and Paper (Riaupulp) said it successfully completed the sale of its power generation assets on June 20, 1997.
Riaupulp said in a statement received by Reuters on Friday that it sold its power assets to P.T. Riau Prima Energi for US$267.7 million.

The sale is part of a previously announced strategy to focus its resources on its core business of producing pulp, to achieve cost reductions and to increase the financial performance of its under-utilised assets, the statement said.
Riaupulp is a subsidiary of Asia Pacific Resources International Holdings Ltd (APRIL).
